timing_scope: Time from local tidy invocation (before native scene construction, after validating inputs) to first post-command native tick with at least 0.001 radians of arm joint change. Report p50 and p95 on cases with a detected move, sample count and missing count. A no-op has null latency to first move. Also report decision latency on every decided case, including no-ops. All values are local wall clock; exclude historical reference capture, asset download, CLI process startup and HTTP transport.
